claims: National Siblings Day is celebrated annually on April 10th.
National Siblings Day was founded by Claudia Evart in 1995 to honor her late siblings.
Claudia Evart selected April 10th in memory of her late sister, Lisette.
National Siblings Day is not a federal holiday.
Governors in 49 states have issued proclamations to recognize National Siblings Day.
Popular social media hashtags for National Siblings Day include #NationalSiblingsDay and #SiblingLove
